notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, and Wayward Disciple triggers if it is on the battlefield.
Resolve the Wayward Disciple trigger, if applicable, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
When the Graveborn enters the battlefield, Pious Evangel triggers if it is on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Nether Traitor triggers, and Wayward Disciple triggers if it is on the battlefield.
Resolve the Wayward Disciple trigger, if applicable, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Nether Traitor trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Nether Traitor enters the battlefield, Pious Evangel triggers if it is on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.
